synopsis: India's Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) issues circulars under the Coal Mines Regulations 2017, using regulation 216(2) as their legal basis [f15587, f2301]. The cited guidance concerns wheeled trackless transportation machinery and calls for proximity warning or anti-collision devices [f2301, f2133]. These facts establish the regulatory hook and device requirement, but do not specify implementation deadlines or technical acceptance criteria [f2133, f15587, f2301].

relations.note: Both identify regulation 216(2) as the legal hook for DGMS circulars or guidance.
Specifies that the circulars call for proximity warning or anti-collision devices.
Identifies wheeled trackless transportation machinery as the scope of the cited guidance.
